trend_dominated series with high predictability; a simple mean may capture the strong trend without overfitting to noise.
The series has moderate ranking stability and strong trend; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture subtle horizon shifts that a global weighted combo missed.
trend_dominated series with moderate ranking stability – a robust median may outperform weighted when errors are correlated.
trend_dominated series with moderate ranking stability suggests a robust trimmed mean may outperform weighted.
Try a DBA combination, which may exploit the moderate ranking stability and trend dominance while reducing bias from a few strong models.
Test a weighted combination that uses per‑horizon top‑k mean (w5) to capture possible horizon‑specific strengths while still weighting across models.
stable pool weighted by inverse error
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a per-horizon weighted approach may capture subtle horizon shifts.
per‑horizon softmax weighting on a stable, small pool
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a weighted combination over a small stable pool may benefit from per-horizon selection, so try best-per-horizon weights on pool2.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4258. Series context: trend strength 0.9337 and seasonal strength 0.0658; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.353); 9 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 10.369.
